To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a categorization of design processes for personalized and customised products through the use additive manufacturing in three process types.

we developed three process types for customised and personalized products through the use additive manufacturing: (1) special design, (2) specific adaptation, and (3) standardised individualisation and we examined the influence of initial customer involvement and the preplanning of the customer-specification in medical development of a modular neurovascular model.
the design process for customised products through AM can be classified into three process types: (1) special design, (2) specific adaptation, and (3) standardised individualisation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design process for personalised products in the context of AM and the impact of customer involvement and pre-planning on the design process.
the development of a design methodology for the integration of AM into the development of customised and personalised medical devices.
the development of a design process for the customisation and personalisation of products in the medical domain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the process type specific adaptation is the most promising for the medical application of vascular models in neurovascular training setups.
the design process for the customisation of vascular models is not yet mature.
the design process is not only influenced by the individualisation of the product, but also by other factors such as the initial customer involvement and the level of pre-planning.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the design process of vascular models is characterised as a specific adaptation.

the use of AM for personalised products is a complex design process, where the design process is influenced by initial customer involvement, preplanning of the customer specification and product complexity.
the use of additive manufacturing enables a wide variety of customisation options.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the design process for personalised products can be categorised according to the degree of customer involvement in design, the degree of individualisation, and the degree to which design can be automated.
the design process for customised and personalised products through additive manufacturing can be classified into three process types.
a design for additive manufacturing process can be categorised into three types: special design (SD), specific adaptation (SA), and standardised individualization (SI).
